name: Mateus Marques
role: Systems Programmer | Low-level C | Linux Internals

aboutme.text: Systems programmer with a Master's in Physics from the University of São Paulo (USP). I'm passionate about low-level C programming and Unix internals, and I'm currently studying kernel development by researching with NetBSD source code. I work as a cybersecurity analyst and have CTF experience in x86-64 assembly, reverse engineering, and exploits.

list.company: G4F | Secretaria de Governo de Goiás (SGG)

Data engineering with Python (Web Scraping, API integrations, GLPI ticket automation), PostgreSQL administration, CI/CD with Jenkins, and basic JavaScript Full-Stack development.
